snippet.title: [Trailer] Desktop Idle Game Loafing Town - Now Available on Steam
snippet.description:
Developed by GoblinZz and published by IndieArk, the game combines strategic combat with town-building mechanics. It's priced at $6.99, with a 10% discount available for the first two weeks, bringing it down to $6.29.

🔽Steam🔽
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625210/Loafing_Town/
